items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the 2025 income tax assessment
items.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter is dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday) and states no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date, so the posting day is the printed date, 19.11.2026. Posted after 1 Jan 2025, so delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting (§122 Abs.2 Nr.1 AO, PostModG): Nov 19 (day 0, not counted) → Nov 20 (1) → Nov 21 (2) → Nov 22 (3) → Nov 23 (4). Nov 23, 2026 is a Monday, not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday, so (tax-office rule under §108 Abs.3 AO) no shift is needed; deemed delivery = 23.11.2026. The one-month objection period under §355 Abs.1 AO runs from this delivery day per §108 Abs.1 AO / §188 Abs.2 BGB and ends on the day with the same number one month later: 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). This day is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Saarland, so the deadline does not shift (§108 Abs.3 AO). Final day for the objection to reach the Finanzamt: 23.12.2026.
